knowledge_snippets: [manual_peripherals#Battery cameras (CAM-S1)] CAM-S1 runs on a rechargeable battery lasting 3 to 6 months. Below 10 percent the camera disables live view and may miss events; below 3 percent it goes offline. Charge with the supplied USB-C cable for about 6 hours. Frequent motion events in busy areas shorten battery life; enable power-saving mode.

[historical_cases#H-01 Garage camera keeps dropping] Customer reported a CAM-S1 in a detached garage going offline several times a day. RSSI was -86 dBm; all other devices normal. Installing an RP-1 repeater solved it. Resolved at frontline.

[escalation_policy#Close at frontline (L1)] Uplink loss of the base station, pairing timeouts, capacity limit reached, weak signal of a single device, low battery, outdated peripheral firmware that upgrades successfully via OTA, and full storage. Provide the customer with step-by-step instructions and confirm the issue is resolved.

[historical_cases#H-04 Whole house offline] All devices offline, base station LED solid red. Router had been replaced the previous day and the Ethernet cable was in the wrong port. Resolved at frontline.

[historical_cases#H-03 Indoor camera lost after night update] After HB-200 auto-updated to 4.5, a CAM-I2 running 1.2 disconnected with E-305. OTA not offered for this hardware revision. Escalated; FAE confirmed protocol v2 dropped and arranged a compatibility firmware. Escalated correctly.

[manual_peripherals#Factory reset of a peripheral] Hold SYNC for 15 seconds until the LED flashes white. This removes the peripheral's own binding but does not remove it from the base station table; remove it in the app first, then reset, then pair again.

[manual_base_station#Restart and reset] A short press (1 s) on the rear button restarts the base station without data loss. A long press (10 s) performs a factory reset and erases all bindings; frontline staff must never instruct customers to factory-reset the base station without FAE approval.

[manual_peripherals#Pairing a peripheral] Put the base station into pairing mode from the app (Add Device). Then hold the SYNC button on the camera or sensor for 3 seconds until its LED blinks blue. Keep the peripheral within 1 metre of the base station during pairing. Pairing times out after 120 seconds. After pairing, the device can be moved to its final location.
